parameters.text:
=Classify this document carefully. Look at ALL visible content — text, layout, logos, fields, and structure.

Return ONLY a JSON object with no extra text:
{"category": "khmer_id", "confidence": 95}

Categories:
- khmer_id = Cambodian National ID card (ប័ណ្ណសញ្ជាតិ). Has Khmer script, MRZ at bottom, national emblem.
- passport = Any passport booklet. Has MRZ (2 or 3 lines), passport photo, country code.
- cv = Resume or Curriculum Vitae. Has work history, skills, education sections, contact info.
- certificate = Certificate, diploma, award, license. Has recipient name, issuing organization, date issued.
- invoice = Invoice, bill, receipt, statement of account.
{{ $json.extractedText ? '\n\nExtracted document text for reference:\n' + $json.extractedText.slice(0, 3000) : '' }}

options.systemMessage: You are a precise document type classifier. Analyze the document visually and by text content. Output ONLY valid JSON — no markdown, no explanation. Format: {"category": "khmer_id|passport|cv|certificate|invoice", "confidence": <number 0-100>}

parameters.text:
=You are scanning a Cambodian National ID card (ប័ណ្ណសញ្ជាតិខ្មែរ). Extract ALL fields exactly as printed. Do not translate, correct, or infer anything.

Return ONLY this JSON object — no markdown, no extra text:
{
  "id_number": "",
  "name_khmer": "",
  "name_latin": "",
  "date_of_birth": "",
  "gender": "",
  "height": "",
  "place_of_birth": "",
  "address": "",
  "issue_date": "",
  "expiry_date": "",
  "noted": "",
  "mrz_line1": "",
  "mrz_line2": "",
  "mrz_line3": ""
}

Field notes:
- id_number: 9-digit number (e.g. 250339847)
- name_khmer: Full name in Khmer script exactly as printed
- name_latin: Full name in Latin/Roman uppercase (e.g. LEAK CHANMOLIKAK)
- date_of_birth: DD.MM.YYYY format (e.g. 12.05.2004)
- gender: Khmer script ប្រុស or ស្រី
- height: With unit (e.g. 164 ស.ម)
- place_of_birth: Full birthplace with commune/district/province in Khmer
- address: Full address with village/commune/district/province in Khmer
- issue_date & expiry_date: DD.MM.YYYY
- noted: Physical identification mark
- mrz_line1/2/3: Exact MRZ characters — only A-Z, 0-9, < — no spaces
{{ $json.extractedText ? '\nExtracted text:\n' + $json.extractedText.slice(0, 2000) : '' }}

options.systemMessage: You are a precision OCR engine for Cambodian National ID cards. Extract text EXACTLY as it appears — never translate, correct, or fill in data. Output ONLY valid JSON.

parameters.text:
=You are scanning a passport. Extract ALL visible fields exactly as printed. Do not translate, correct, or infer.

Return ONLY this JSON object — no markdown, no extra text:
{
  "passport_type": "",
  "country_code": "",
  "passport_number": "",
  "surname": "",
  "given_names": "",
  "nationality": "",
  "date_of_birth": "",
  "gender": "",
  "place_of_birth": "",
  "date_of_issue": "",
  "date_of_expiry": "",
  "personal_number": "",
  "mrz_line1": "",
  "mrz_line2": ""
}

Field notes:
- passport_type: P, PD, etc.
- country_code: 3-letter ISO code (e.g. KHM)
- mrz_line1 & mrz_line2: ONLY A-Z, 0-9, < characters — 44 chars each — no spaces
- For empty/unreadable fields return ""
{{ $json.extractedText ? '\nExtracted text:\n' + $json.extractedText.slice(0, 2000) : '' }}

parameters.text:
=You are scanning a certificate, diploma, or award document. Extract ALL fields exactly as printed — do not translate or paraphrase.

Return ONLY this JSON object — no markdown, no extra text:
{
  "certificate_title": "",
  "recipient_name": "",
  "title_awarded": "",
  "issuing_organization": "",
  "issuing_country": "",
  "date_issued": "",
  "date_expiry": "",
  "certificate_number": "",
  "authorized_by": "",
  "grade_or_result": "",

}

Field notes:
- certificate_title: The specific, meaningful title (e.g. 'Python Data Science Toolbox', 'Bachelor of Computer Science') — NOT a generic label
- recipient_name: Exact name as printed on the certificate
- issuing_organization: Full official name of institution
- For empty/absent fields return ""
{{ $json.extractedText ? '\nExtracted document text:\n' + $json.extractedText.slice(0, 3000) : '' }}

options.systemMessage: You are a precision OCR engine for certificates and diplomas. Extract text EXACTLY as printed. Never paraphrase or translate. The certificate_title must be the specific subject/topic name, not a generic label. Return ONLY valid JSON.

parameters.text:
=You are scanning an invoice or billing document. Extract ALL fields exactly as printed — do not translate, calculate, or infer anything.

Return ONLY this JSON object — no markdown, no extra text:
{
  "invoice_number": "",
  "invoice_date": "",
  "due_date": "",
  "vendor": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "phone": "",
    "email": "",
    "vat_number": ""
  },
  "customer": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "phone": "",
    "email": ""
  },
  "items": [
    { "description": "", "quantity": null, "unit_price": null, "amount": null }
  ],
  "subtotal": null,
  "tax_amount": null,
  "discount_amount": null,
  "total_amount": null,
  "currency": "",
  "payment_terms": "",
  "bank_details": {
    "bank_name": "",
    "account_number": "",
    "swift_code": ""
  }
}

Rules:
- Extract ONLY what is physically on the document
- Numerical amounts should be numbers or floats, not strings (e.g. 150.00, not "$150.00")
- Return "" or null for empty/absent fields
